contests.title: Carroll Community School District — Measure DA: School improvement bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Carroll County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Carroll Community School District in the County of Carroll, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $51,000,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip additions to the high school and to remodel, repair, improve, furnish, and equip the high school and middle school, including site improvements, to facilitate the closure of Adams Elementary School?

contests.title: Pocahontas Area Community School District — Measure RQ: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the
Pocahontas Area Community School
District in the Counties of Pocahontas,
Calhoun and Palo Alto, State of Iowa,
be authorized to contract indebtedness
and issue General Obligation Bonds in
an amount not to exceed $20,000,000
to provide funds to remodel, repair,
improve, and equip the middle/high
school and elementary school, including
career and technical education and
classroom spaces; to build, furnish, and
equip additions to the middle/high
school and elementary school, including
site improvements; for playground
improvements at the elementary school;
and to build, furnish, and equip a central
office and regional learning center
building and a transportation facility,
including site improvements?

contests.title: Knoxville Community School District — Measure ON: New elementary school bonds

provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the
Knoxville Community School District in
the County of Marion, State of Iowa, be
authorized to contract indebtedness and
issue General Obligation Bonds in an
amount not to exceed $15,300,000 to
provide funds to build, furnish, and
equip a new elementary building on the
Veterans District Site, including related
site improvements?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $51 million in general-obligation bonds for high school additions, high school and middle school renovations and equipment, and site improvements, to facilitate closing Adams Elementary School.

Authorizes up to $20 million in general-obligation bonds for middle/high school and elementary renovations and additions, including career and technical education and classrooms, an elementary playground, a central office and regional learning center, a transportation facility and related site improvements.
Authorizes up to $15.3 million in general-obligation bonds to build, furnish and equip a new elementary school building on the Veterans District site, including related site improvements.
